clusters.name: Shibuya
clusters.description: Home base energy. Crossing, Hachiko, Center-Gai, PARCO, Miyashita Park all within 5-8 min of each other. Dogenzaka hill (Hikiniku, Good Wood, Uobei, JBS, Street Kart) is west, Nonbei Yokocho and Grandfather's are east.
clusters.good_day: Any day. Morning (before 10) for a clean Crossing and Hachiko shot, 15:30-16:00 for Shibuya Sky sunset (~16:35), night for Center-Gai, Nonbei, bars. Hikiniku CLOSED WED. Grandfather's CLOSED MON. Street Kart needs the IDP.
